package ingest
import (
	"context"
	"github.com/peasant-labs/peasant/third_party/zombiezen-sqlite"
	"github.com/peasant-labs/peasant/third_party/zombiezen-sqlite/sqlitex"
)
type zombiezenOpenCodeSQLiteSource struct { conn *sqlite.Conn }
func (s *zombiezenOpenCodeSQLiteSource) executeRowsLocked(ctx context.Context, statement string, alternate string, args []any, result func(*sqlite.Stmt) error) error {
	_, _, err := s.conn.PrepareTransient(alternate)
	if err != nil { return err }
	return sqlitex.ExecuteTransient(s.conn, statement, &sqlitex.ExecOptions{Args: args, ResultFunc: result})
}
